claims.text: A table has pooled treated 44%, control 66%, but +10 percentage points within each stratum. If the stratum is a pre-treatment confounder and adjustment assumptions hold, which contrast targets the total effect?
claims.source: src/demos/probability/p100-split-or-pool/spec.ts; exact finite illustration specified in manager numericCase: Use stratum rates: treatment low80%, high40%; control low70%, high30%. Treatment mix90%high gives44%, control mix10%high gives66%. If strata pre-treatment confounder adjust gives+10pp; if strata mediator, adjustment removes indirect path. State graph assumptions explicitly.

claims.text: Balancing a confounder blocks a noncausal path. Holding a mediator fixed blocks part of the causal pathway instead; interpreting that as a direct effect requires additional assumptions. The arrows, timing and target matter.
